upper_support_edges: For packed_support_edge_pair_count,double_support_edge_pair_count,theta_inner_support_edge_pair_count: each six-row summary must contain nonnegative base10 integer counts,identical across unchanged-geometry probes; completion integer totals equal the six-row sums; packed total strictly>0. kernel_edge_grad_bound_max must be finite/nonnegative per summary,and completion equals their positive maximum. Sample per-native-ID integer counts must remain constant across unchanged-geometry probes and not exceed whole-probe counts; sample bounds remain finite/nonnegative and not exceed whole-probe maximum. Existing Ratio<=1 and all original safety/count/metadata gates unchanged. Upper-support edge uses explicit zero reference plus complete omitted-or-included envelope; never absorb zero-distance ambiguity or infer exact neighbor membership.
r1_retention: r1 failed support-reference attempt remains unchanged. r2 component source/build/program are reused without alteration, while its incomplete Debug probe/output and absent native exit are preserved; neither failed r1 nor incomplete r2 is adopted as passing.
support_geometry_invariance: Component Force() checks current/native ID closure, exact X0 positions and within-call declared input bytes; RunCellDivide uses unchanged seed positions. Each later probe also explicitly compares C/FS/normal bitwise against first probe. Packed/double/inner support classifications depend only on captured geometry, KernelSize2, fixed KernelH/PosCellSize and fixed error formulas, not velocities/p/sigma. Therefore equal per-probe support-edge counts are a deliberate external invariance screen, not an assumption that packed and double support sets are identical.
